changes.comment: Prerendered content is kept: an element whose host already holds the server's render of the same template does not re-render, fires `did-render` once and is ready at once (never `delaying-ready`); `persist-content` keeps those nodes across toggles and `pre-fetch="idle"` does not run during a prerender
A first mount into a `host-ref` selector no longer clears the host or fires `did-unrender`: what the host holds stays until the first render replaces it
